scope: Current original PDF and DOCX files selected by MIME or suffix; nested archive documents excluded.
limitations: Text extraction is not semantic review or visual/layout verification.
PDF text order and Arabic shaping may be imperfect; page strings retained without inferred corrections.
Pages lacking text are candidates for scanned/image-only/blank pages, not confirmed scans; OCR not performed.
DOCX OOXML text parts include headers, footers, foot/endnotes and comments when present; visible/deleted/instruction segments are separately labelled.
Tables preserve row/cell-to-paragraph structure; pagination, numbering, fields, tracked-change visibility and layout are not resolved.
Embedded objects/macros and external relationships were not executed or fetched.
Images, charts, equations and nontext visual meaning remain pending.
No public document contents, names or private source identifiers included.
This bounded extraction does not complete the 1399-original engineering audit.
validation_notes: Two incomplete intermediate PDF records were detected during independent page-count validation, then re-extracted sequentially and all page sequences verified. No unverified completion retained.
Images were not decoded for semantic review. Later verification uses top-level image resource counts only.
